name: softrest
_note: a hand RESTING on her (the bump, a thigh) seen side-on: the fingers softly together, each a little curled so they follow the curve under them, more toward the little finger, the tips just apart; the thumb along the top. With fx.fingersIn 0.3 (on the bump) to 0.5 (round the bump's underside, on a thigh). 'siderest' (10–12° every finger, one angle) read as fingers 'pointed directly out at a specific angle' (Harry, round 8). Round 9: the fingers TOGETHER (spread −0.5…1°): at −2…4° they fanned into 'a second fan… four separate strokes' beside the stills' one mass (side-on round 8, every lens) Round 14: the knuckles all at ONE angle (12°: the fingers bend together off the palm, parallel, as a hand drapes over a curve) and the grading at the middle joints (12–20°, more toward the little finger); graded at the knuckles (12–20°) they diverged from the knuckle line and every lens read 'a fan from the knuckle' beside the stills' parallel fingers (round 13); knuckles at 2° left too little curl in the picture (QA curl 2–3°, Harry's 'pointed directly out') Round 15: the middle joints 20–36° (index to little), the end joints 12–18°: at 12–20° the body lens read the parallel fingers 'straight to the tip at 1:1' beside the stills' curl under the form; the knuckles stay at one angle so they don't fan
